“Because I’m a lifelong Republican.”

Sen. John Fetterman draws a wave of laughter after accidentally switching parties mid-answer when asked why he doesn’t become an independent.

The Pennsylvania Democrat immediately realizes the mistake, puts his hand to his head and predicts

"I am King Tutankhamun."

Newly surfaced bodycam shows Elijah Hemingway making the bizarre declaration to Florida deputies during an April 2025 encounter.

Hemingway is now accused of stabbing a beloved doctor to death

Police say Dr. Idris Evans and his wife were attacked in bed
